operations.name: Bryan Omar Roa

expected.name: Bryan Omar Roa
expected.description: Bryan Omar Roa was arrested on June 13, 2026 and accused of participating in an anti-government plot to attack the UFC Freedom 250 event at the White House. A federal grand jury later charged him and seven others with conspiracy to provide material support to terrorists and conspiracy to commit murder. He was jailed without bond while the case was pending.

operations.source: Individually identified mugshot, FBI Los Angeles June 16, 2026 release, preserved through Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mugshot_of_Bryan_Omar_Roa.png ; credited original https://x.com/FBILosAngeles/status/2067035684972454272 . Original downloaded pixels preserved; no crop or generative edit. Pending charges remain allegations.
